items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: I go back to my doctor, Dr. Arthur Logan, and he take an x-ray of my lung.

ctx.x: I said, "Something's wrong. I got to go back home. I got to go home. There's definitely something wrong with me." I had been to the doctor before we left here. And I go back to my doctor, Dr. Arthur Logan, and he take an x-ray of my lung. And we was leaving out the next day.
